data.content_ref: inline:SRC_003 contradicts SRC_004: topological isolation (DAG structure) cannot provide superior correlated failure resilience if the observer-bias mechanism holds, because the DAG merely fragments and hides the catastrophic shared-cause failures rather than preventing them. Refuted if topological isolation provably reduces the absolute frequency of shared-cause failures (not just their observability), demonstrating causal isolation independent of the observation framework.
